title: Social Sentiment
description: A snapshot of social-intelligence observations for a single asset from a single producer (e.g. lunarcrush). The platform aggregates data items by (asset, dataType=socialSentiment, source); each subsequent record from the same source overwrites the producer's previous snapshot. Multi-producer aggregation falls out naturally — different producers contribute distinct (asset, dataType=socialSentiment, source) rows. A producer ships every metric it publishes for the asset in one snapshot via the `values` map keyed by semantic metric name, so consumers can look up a known metric across producers. All observations describe the trailing `window` (default 24h) ending at `timestamp`. Metrics are descriptive market-attention data, not recommendations.

timestamp.description: Producer timestamp at which the snapshot was emitted, epoch milliseconds. Used as the default for any value entry that omits its own `timestamp`.

window.description: Trailing observation window the metrics describe, ending at `timestamp`. ISO-8601-style duration shorthand: "1h", "24h", "7d", "30d".

topic.description: Producer-side topic or symbol the asset was resolved to (e.g. "bitcoin", "$coin"). Lets consumers audit the identifier mapping from ISIN or CAIP-19 to the producer's namespace.

symbol.description: Ticker or coin symbol at the producer (e.g. "COIN", "BTC").

methodology.description: Link to the producer's published metric definitions and methodology.

values.description: Map of metricType → observation. Keys are semantic metric names so consumers can look up a known metric across producers. Expected vocabulary: "sentiment" (share of positive posts, 0–100 %), "engagements" (interactions on posts about the asset), "mentions" (posts about the asset), "creators" (unique accounts posting), "socialDominance" (share of all tracked social volume, %), "marketDominance" (share of total market capitalisation, %), "galaxyScore" (producer composite health score, 0–100), "altRank" (producer rank across assets; lower is stronger), "topicRank" (producer rank across all social topics), "socialVolume", "newsMentions". New keys may be added as use cases arise; consumers should ignore unrecognised keys.

value.description: Raw value, scaled by `decimal`. Strings are permitted to preserve precision for values that overflow IEEE 754 (~2^53).

decimal.description: Scale factor — human-readable value = value / 10^decimal. 0 for integer values (counts, ranks).

unit.description: Optional. How to read the value: a count of events, a percentage (0–100), a bounded score, or an ordinal rank.

change.description: Optional. Relative change versus the previous period of the same `window`, as a percentage (e.g. 27.03 for +27.03 %). Lets consumers act on momentum without keeping their own history.

timestamp.description: Optional. Per-value timestamp in epoch milliseconds. Falls back to the snapshot's top-level `timestamp` if absent.

signature.description: Optional. DER-encoded signature over the observation, when the producer is a signing oracle. Passed through verbatim for downstream verification.

networks.description: Optional. Breakdown of `engagements` and `mentions` by social network for the same window. Keys are network names ("x", "youtube", "reddit", "tiktok", "instagram", "news").

themes.description: Optional. Producer-derived narrative themes for the window, each with its share of the conversation. Supportive and critical themes are distinguished by `stance` so a consumer can render them separately.

theme.description: Short theme label, e.g. "FXRP collateral expands".

weight.description: Share of the window's conversation attributed to this theme, in percent.

summary.description: One or two sentence producer summary of the theme.

sampleSize.description: Optional. Number of posts underlying the snapshot. Consumers should treat snapshots with a small sample as low confidence.
